description: Implementation of the RenderTargetVk class, a wrapper around Vulkan renderable resources using ImageView, including methods for initialization, layout transitions, dependency management, and resource access.

classes.name: RenderTargetVk
classes.description: A class managing Vulkan render target resources, including image layout transitions, dependency tracking, and resource access for rendering operations.

methods.name: RenderTargetVk
methods.description: Default constructor initializing members to null or zero.

methods.name: RenderTargetVk
methods.description: Move constructor transferring resource ownership from another instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the render target with image, image views, level, and layer indices.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the render target to default null/zero state.

methods.name: onColorDraw
methods.description: Prepares the image for color drawing, including layout transition and dependency setup.

methods.name: onDepthStencilDraw
methods.description: Prepares the image for depth/stencil drawing, including layout transition and dependency setup.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns a reference to the image helper for reading.

methods.name: getImage (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the image helper for reading.

methods.name: getImageView
methods.description: Retrieves the image view for the current level and layer.

methods.name: getImageFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the image.

methods.name: getExtents
methods.description: Returns the extents of the image at the current level.

methods.name: updateSwapchainImage
methods.description: Updates the stored image and image views, typically after a swapchain image change.

methods.name: getImageForRead
methods.description: Prepares and returns the image for reading with specified layout and dependency.

methods.name: getImageForWrite
methods.description: Prepares and returns the image for writing with specified dependency.

methods.name: flushStagedUpdates
methods.description: Flushes any staged updates to the image, recording necessary commands.

methods.name: onImageViewGraphAccess
methods.description: Marks the image view graph as accessed for dependency tracking.
